name: sharp-stub
description: Local stub that replaces the real `sharp` package for this deployment. This app never uses next/image (images.unoptimized: true in next.config.ts), so the real `sharp` — Next's optional dependency for server-side image optimization — is never actually invoked. The real package ships per-platform native .node binaries that Cloudflare Workers' esbuild bundling step cannot handle, so it's overridden to this stub via package.json's "overrides" field instead of being installed at all.
